liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cold Rain and Snow** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this a rare song, and it leads into the second-set jam sequence; Reviewer says this was rarely played in 1977, like several other songs common in the 1980s [12][22]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Blazing version, flowing seamlessly into Estimated Prophet; Reviewer's favorite version of Eyes [16][18]
- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Jerry's closing guitar is both heartbreaking and energetic; The transition from Stella Blue into the Playin' reprise is brilliant [17][23]
- **Playin' In The Band** (2 reviews): Playin' flows seamlessly through Eyes, Estimated and The Other One in a mind-boggling jam segue; Run from Playin' through Eyes, Estimated, Drums, Other One, Iko and Stella is spellbinding [12][23]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Opener Bertha smokes right from the start [20]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Jerry stands out on this song and on It Must Have Been The Roses [12]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Intense version; its peak has Jerry strumming furiously [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **Sleigh Ride**: back after 172 archived shows (1423 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [24]
- **Stay**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **Rip It Up**: back after 172 archived shows (1423 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [24]
- **Blue Suede Shoes**: back after 172 archived shows (1423 days); rare: 3 archived performances [24]
- **Cumberland Blues**: back after 131 archived shows (1113 days) [24]
- **Thirty Days**: back after 172 archived shows (1423 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd77-11-04.sbd.unknown.2595.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 27 songs; 183 min; rated 4.61/5 by 45 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard keeps the energy of the very good audience tape and removes occasional crowd chatter; The audience tape sounds underwater because of the room; the soundboard is beautiful [15][19]
- **gd1977-11-04.mtx.chappell.SB5.29091.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 163 min; rated 4.75/5 by 16 [2]. Said about its sound: Jerry Moore's front-of-board audience tape is excellent; the soundboard has everyone balanced in the mix [2]
- **gd1977-11-04.sbd.braverman.3739.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 161 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [10]
- **gd1977-11-04.139656.sbd.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 158 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- It was Colgate's homecoming; on the audience tape one fan greets a buddy by name [15]
- The venue was basically an ice rink covered with corrugated steel [19]
- Small basketball auditorium; the crowd sounds small but very enthusiastic [20]
- A weird, powerful night during Colgate University's homecoming weekend [2]
- The audience tape has a prominent, wildly enthusiastic crowd, and the uploader recommends it [10]
- Reviewer ranks this among their favorite 1977 shows, alongside Englishtown and Broome County, for Jerry's harder tone and jamming [15]
- Reviewer rates this Stella Blue above the one on So Many Roads [17]
- Reviewer thinks this show beats Dick's Picks 34 and should have been chosen for release instead [18]
- The following night's show was later released as a Dick's Pick [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-11-04.sbd.unknown.2595.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard lineage: master reel to DAT to CD-R [1]
- **gd1977-11-04.mtx.chappell.SB5.29091.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Sick Bits Vol. 5 Matrix By Chris Chappell [2]. Also: Matrix of the soundboard (MR>DAT>CD-R) and a Sony ECM 33Ps/TC-158 audience tape, edited in Vegas 5 [2]
- **gd1977-11-04.sbd.braverman.3739.shnf**: transferred by Peter Braverman; source: SBD:MR > DAT > CD-R [10]. Also: A patch from an audience tape restores the full Jones Gang introduction to set 2 [10]
- **gd1977-11-04.139656.sbd.flac1644**: transferred by Unknown; source: This source is a DAE of the GDLive material listed as source ID 2595 ; Source/Lineage: SBD Master > DAT > dl gd server > CD-R (15+ yrs) > xACT 2.41 (ffp’s,… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Patrick Harbron: [1977-11-04 Cotterrell Gym, Colgate U., Hamilton, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1977-11-04-cotterrell-gym-colgate-u-hamilton-ny-usa/) [25]

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Cotterell Gym - November 4, 1977](https://www.dead.net/show/november-4-1977) [28]
